label: A capability declaration is a two-way honesty contract: undeclared must return explicit unsupported with an empty receipt and must not reach the provider; declared must succeed
ChannelCapabilities is a 17-field versioned record (VERSION=2) with eight typed sub-records, a pessimistic unknown() default and an extensions escape hatch
AccountCapabilities puts five optional account-health booleans plus health text and proactive_target on the capability record, so prerequisites are data not a send-time failure
The acknowledge point is a declared per-adapter policy with four positions (AfterReceiveRecord default, AfterAgentDispatch, AfterDurableSend, Manual), not one global rule

Retry policy separates permanent from transient failures via eight literal patterns plus three substring heuristics, so a permanent failure does not consume an attempt; 5 retries over a 0/5s/25s/2min/10min ladder

Durability is negotiated down and the loss reported: required capabilities are derived from the payload shape, and a transport that cannot honour Required degrades to BestEffort returning missing_capabilities
New adapter capabilities arrive as trait methods with an explicit-unsupported default, so existing transports keep compiling and honestly report they cannot do the new thing
